correctness.rationale: A degree-five positive polynomial gives a bounded strict six-isometry; reciprocal telescoping gives all Cauchy-dual moments. Laplace inversion gives a unique finite signed measure and reduces Hausdorff positivity to F_rho>=0. Stationary points and their exact values are determined by tan(z)=z. Q_rho(z2)=2 has a unique positive root; below it F_rho(z2)<0. Above it, rho>1/z2 and Q_rho strictly decreases beyond z2, bounding every later local minimum. All parameters and boundaries are covered analytically; 344 finite checker tests corroborate elementary formulas but do not certify infinite-dimensional conclusions.
